title: alchemilla podophylla
intro: Alchemilla podophylla, commonly known as the Lady's Mantle, is a flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Alchemilla podophylla include its ability to help in wound healing, reduce menstrual cramps, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of the plant include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its healing and soothing effects. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla podophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
